project.title: NouGenNews — Elite News Intelligence Pipeline
project.description: Elite RSS ingestion, article image scraping, Google Drive storage, and real-time news feed, engineered for maximum throughput and minimal operational overhead.

sections.title: 📋 Table of Contents
sections.content: A high-level overview of the operational doctrine for this pipeline.

sections.title: ⚙️ Installation and Deployment Doctrine
sections.content: Establish the operational baseline by cloning the repository and provisioning the necessary runtime environment. This sequence ensures all dependencies are correctly mapped before initiating the feed ingestion phase.

sections.title: 🏗️ Core Architecture: The Throughput Engine
sections.content: The system operates on a parallel, staged execution model designed for maximum leverage. We utilize parallel XML fetching, an 8-lane scrape pool employing head-only streaming (16KB reads) to minimize bandwidth expenditure, and a 6-lane Drive pool for concurrent storage. All persistent writes are consolidated into a single batched SQLite transaction, maximizing I/O efficiency.

sections.title: ⚡ Performance Metrics: Quantifying Leverage
sections.content: The pipeline demonstrates significant operational gains. Key metrics include an 8x speedup in scrape concurrency, a ~50x acceleration in DB writes via batched transactions, and reduced bandwidth usage by ~12x through early-abort streaming. This architecture prioritizes speed and resource efficiency over brute-force processing.

sections.title: 🔑 Key Operational Techniques (Doctrine)
sections.content: The system relies on several core techniques that define its operational advantage: Zero-Dep Concurrency Semaphores to manage resource contention, Early-Abort Streaming Scrapers to terminate connections immediately upon finding necessary data, and DNS Pre-Warming to eliminate cold lookups from the critical path. These techniques ensure predictable, high-velocity execution.

sections.title: 🔗 Integration Points and Data Persistence
sections.content: Data persistence leverages a single batched SQLite transaction for atomic writes, ensuring data integrity without the overhead of numerous individual fsync operations. Image assets are managed via Domain-Wide Delegation with Google Drive, utilizing a proxy endpoint (`/api/media/[fileId]`) for zero API cost storage.
